name: Fiat 147
desc: A cheerful yellow Fiat 147 character seen head-on, silhouette traced from the reference photo: flat roof cap, steep A-pillar rake, flared fenders with the real concave gap between the tires, chrome-bezel round headlight 'eyes', the black grille with its red/chrome/red accent stripe, chrome bumper with rubber trim, amber corner indicators, and a white '147' plate.
